title: Community Information Session: License Plate Reader Technology and Cameras
notes: Norwood Police Department community information session for Norwood residents about Flock Safety cameras and license plate reader (LPR) technology. Chief Christopher Padden and the department plan to explain what the technology is and is not, why NPD uses it, examples of its use in investigations and public safety, what information is collected, data-retention practices, system access and auditing, restrictions on sharing/use of Norwood data, and department safeguards. An open resident Q&A will follow. The meeting is intended to address public questions about privacy, data retention, information sharing, accountability, and law-enforcement use of LPR systems.

title: Electronics Recycling Event
notes:
Community electronics, appliance and battery recycling, plus reusable bicycles. Open to residents of all towns; rain or shine. Part of the proceeds benefit St. Timothy Parish.

$5 each: Computer towers, laptops, DVD players, VCRs, small printers, stereos, radios, alarm clocks, speakers, video game consoles, table lamps, fans, hair dryers, curling irons, projectors, power tools, drills, cameras, clocks, trophies, frying pans, holiday lights and other small electronics.

$10 each: Small household appliances, vacuum cleaners/Roomba, toaster ovens, ceiling fans, floor lamps, air fryers, electric grills, hot plates, small radiators, keyboard pianos, coffee makers, ice makers, sewing machines, car seats and strollers.

$20 each: Flat-screen computer monitors, microwaves, dehumidifiers, air conditioners, water coolers, large printers/copiers, leaf blowers, chainsaws, heat lamps, artificial Christmas trees, fire extinguishers and empty propane tanks.

$25 each: TVs up to 26 inches, CRT monitors, outdoor grills and dorm-sized refrigerators.

$30 each: TVs between 26 and 35 inches, white goods, washing machines, dryers, stoves, dishwashers, large appliances, large yard equipment, treadmills, exercise equipment, snow blowers, lawn mowers, rototillers, large generators, motors, water tanks and water heaters.

$35 each: TVs over 36 inches, large refrigerators and ride-on lawn mowers.

$40 each: Projection TVs.

FREE (cash donations appreciated): Cell phones, reusable bicycles, video game media and accessories, wires, cables, chargers, car/truck batteries, DVDs, keyboards and tablets.

Arrival: Follow the cones and workers' directions. Pull your vehicle as close to the truck or dumpster as possible. You may remain in your vehicle; workers will unload your items.

Hard drives will be destroyed during recycling. On-site hard-drive removal is available for an additional charge.

Payment: Cash preferred. Checks accepted for payments over $30.

Questions, business cleanouts or hosting an event: Greendayrecycling.net • GreenDayRecyclingMA@Gmail.com

Prices above are as supplied by the organizer; confirm the fee for a 36-inch TV on-site.
